name: ap-mortgage-rates
title: Average 30-year US mortgage rate climbs to 6.58%, highest level in nearly a year | AP News

knownGaps.why: Editorial prose is not a price column. A single finance article names a GBP5 monthly bill and a GBP7bn debt in the same paragraph, and no page-wide decimal count can render both: the bill needs three decimals to be nonzero, the debt needs none. The rule is right for a shop shelf and structurally unreachable for a news article.
